description: This file contains a shell script used for generating UBI images, including functions for configuring partitions, layout, and serialization, and parsing command-line arguments for customization.

methods.name: ubivol
methods.description: Defines a UBI volume with specific parameters and outputs configuration directives.

methods.name: ubilayout
methods.description: Sets up the layout of UBI volumes based on input parameters and filesystem type.

methods.name: set_ubinize_seq
methods.description: Sets a sequence count or timestamp for ubinize command based on environment variables.
